authorization: physiological_synthesis synthesis/claims ledger only; no new data opening or inferential testing
interpretation_boundary: stable subfeatures describe reproducible contributions within the prespecified compact EEG representation conditional on transferred family geometry; they do not establish causal generators, source localization, or true emotion kinds
signed_delta_and_cosine_decomposition: reported for every authorized feature as descriptive decompositions; not used to redefine the stable-subfeature gate
stable_subfeature_rule: within a heldout_physiological_transfer-authorized contrast-block pair: RMS-share family contrast has the same nonzero direction in Discovery/Validation/Confirmation and the dominant family RMS share is > 1/block_size in all three splits
